# sdlc-processes

The executable software-delivery processes: branch, review, merge, gates, QA, publication, release and the bean lifecycle, with the DMN tables their gateways read in `decisions/`. Was the `sdlc` concern group of `processes/` until cat-harness#991 step 23.2; diagrams elsewhere call them by process id.

Part of [C@T Harness](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `sdlc-processes`, holding `processes`.
